title: IMS Common Cartridge / Thin CC export (fixtures)
context: For lesson plans to be importable into Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Canvas, Moodle, or Blackboard, they must be packaged in a format those systems accept. IMS Common Cartridge (CC) and Thin Common Cartridge (Thin CC) are the open standard package formats for this. Without a Common Cartridge exporter, plans can only reach teachers who manually find and download Markdown files — a significant friction barrier to adoption. This exporter unlocks LMS-based adoption and OER repository submission that requires CC format, making the 'frictionless adoption' goal achievable.
objective: Implement a deterministic IMS Common Cartridge / Thin CC exporter for lesson plans, with committed golden-fixture tests verified in CI against the pinned spec version.
acceptanceCriteria: The exporter takes a lesson plan in Markdown + YAML front-matter and produces a valid IMS Common Cartridge or Thin CC package.
The output is validated against the pinned IMS Common Cartridge spec version (recorded in a specVersions file committed to the repo).

Round-trip import is verified in at least one open LMS (e.g. Canvas LMS demo, Moodle sandbox) — or, where no sandbox is available, captured against the LMS's published import schema with evidence recorded.
LRMI/CASE metadata (from teacher-lesson-plans-casemeta-011) is embedded in the CC package where the spec permits.
Golden-fixture tests are committed: at least one canonical input plan and its expected CC package output are diffed in CI.
The exporter is deterministic; code is MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; no credentials embedded.
resources: teacher-lesson-plans-template-001 — canonical lesson-plan schema and Markdown format
PLAN.md — §Dependencies & integrations (IMS Common Cartridge / Thin CC)
output: A merged PR adding an IMS Common Cartridge / Thin CC exporter with golden-fixture tests and a committed specVersions file, integrated into the CI pipeline.
